probe.error: ERR_PNPM_FETCH_404 GET https://registry.npmjs.org/@rph%2Fresearch: Not Found while installing dependencies of @rph/bridge@0.0.0

diagnosis.root_cause: The workspace pack preserves internal dependency names but does not provide a private registry, file/bundled dependency mapping, or install manifest. pnpm therefore tries the public npm registry for private @rph/* packages.
diagnosis.impact: M0-02a proves build/test/package only. The four tarballs are not yet independently installable and must not be cited as a release artifact set.

required_fix: M5-01 must make the RPH package set installable from the artifact store without the repository or public npm registry: choose and implement one packaging authority (bundled dependencies, private file registry/lock manifest, or aggregated RPH package), then rerun this probe successfully on the clean host.
claim_scope: Implementation-side defect discovery; not independent operator acceptance and not a release PASS.
